relevance_note: The paper describes individual HA20 patients with TNFAIP3 variants, e.g. "P1 was a 15-year-old female with p.T604Rfs*93".
method_note: Read the whole short paper (text, supplementary figure legend, figure legend) manually; no tables to transcribe. Rows were assembled by a small Python script in the scratch directory from hand-chosen spans, then every span was checked verbatim against the Markdown. Scope: 8 labelled HA20 patients (P1-P5 active disease, named in the text; P6-P8 quiescent, labelled only in the Fig 1C legend). The other members of the stated 'cohort of twelve patients with HA20' are not described individually and get no rows; n_patients_reported and cohort_size_as_stated both use the stated 12. P6-P8 get no variant rows: the paper ties no variant information to them beyond the HA20 label; clinical_diagnosis_basis left 'not reported' for them because it is not stated that they belong to the Sanger-diagnosed NIH cohort. Ages for P2-P4 ('aged 28, 32, and 61') assigned in order of mention (P2=28, P3=32, P4=61), read as years at time of report. 'orogenital ulcerations (P1-P4)' (Fig 1B legend) mapped to both oral ulcers and genital ulcers observed. Variant type, zygosity and pathogenicity left 'not reported': the authors do not classify the individual variants (only the general statement that HA20 is caused by heterozygous loss-of-function TNFAIP3 mutations); P5's variant is called 'unreported' (novelty, not a classification). Functional evidence is the cohort-wide statement that NF-κB activity was confirmed by luciferase assay. P5's 'autoinflammatory liver disease/hepatitis' not mapped to checklist 'autoimmune hepatitis' (authors say autoinflammatory). P2 'retinal vasculopathy' not mapped to ocular inflammation or vasculitis. P5 'asymptomatic' was not used to exclude any checklist item. No opportunistic/severe infections and no cardiovascular/thrombotic events are recorded as excluded (group statement) for the four tofacitinib-treated patients (P1, P3, P4, P5); they do not exclude checklist 'recurrent infections' (narrower, during treatment). No previous publication of these patients is stated (ref 2 is cited only for the luciferase assay), so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. Contradictions/inconsistencies in the paper: (1) text says 'P2 declined tofacitinib' and responses in 'all four patients', but Fig 1D shows AIDAI before/after treatment for P1-P3 and Fig 1F and Fig S1C-D show after-treatment data for P1-P5; (2) the text's 'cohort of twelve patients with HA20' vs the Fig 1C legend, where 'twelve subjects' are 8 HA20 patients plus 4 healthy volunteers; (3) Fig S1 legend labels safety panels '1C-D' but refers to '(1F)' and '(1G)'.
